title: Kanye West's Twitter Account Suspended For The 2nd Time In Months
htmlContent:
Days after Chicago rapper agreed to pay Kim Kardashian $200,000 a month in child support. In addition, he is responsible for 50% of their children’s educational and security expenses. Kanye West who goes by the name Ye has been suspended from Twitter yet again!

On the night of December 1st, Ye tweeted a pair of photograph’s one of Twitter CEO Elon Musk. Once upon a time the world richest man who appears to be overweight. Can be seen in photo standing on the edge of a yacht called Zeus.

As he’s being hosed down by another middle aged Caucasian male. Kanye caption read, “Let’s always remember this as my final tweet” #ye24 For the past few months Kanye has been front and centered week after week in the controversially limelight. While some doubt he’ll seek a presidential run in 2024 campaign. Others support him even throughout the disarray and allegations of a mental disorder.

He ended his tweet rampage with a final tweet posting a picture of NBA superstar Chris Paul. Saying “let’s break one last window before we get out of here, I caught this guy with Kim. Goodnight..” implying Kim had an affair for the Phoenix Suns point guard prior to their divorce. Which was finalized in February 2022.

According to TMZ Sports, those claims are false, "The allegation is absolutely false, and just another example of a desperate man trying to shift the focus away from his own wrongdoings.”

Elon Musk said his tweets violated the platform's rules on inciting violence.

Musk replied in a tweet. "I tried my best. Despite that, he again violated our rule against incitement to violence. Account will be suspended". However it’s unclear which tweet provoked Ye’s suspension. A ton of fans and anti-fans, 2.5k plus took to clubhouse in a room hosted by AAYAN FIX MY LIFE my life to express their concerns. Most implicating that Ye mental is unstable to run for presidency in 2024.
